## Checklist

- [ ] The branch name starts with the issue type prefix (`feature/`, `fix/`, `update/` or `docs/`).
- [ ] Commit messages follow the `type (#issue-number): description` format.
- [ ] A changeset has been added, if the change affects a published package.
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated.
- [ ] Documentation has been added or updated. The guides are written in the [website repository](https://github.com/axisparkjs/website) and the API reference is generated from the TSDoc comments, so keep them accurate.
